finding: The retained Valhalla trace uses OSM way 265459454, a distinct bypass south of the toll roof, not a displaced version of paid lane 265459419. Current OSM also lacks toll/access restrictions on this bypass. The IGN orthophoto confirms a separate carriageway outside the roof; imagery alone does not establish permitted traffic or payment conditions. Do not widen the roof gate or classify the bypass as free without resolving those conditions.

imagery.limitation: Read-only visual evidence. Capture date not established; no access or toll conclusion from imagery alone.
